text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, elevated ferritin, and a significantly increased INR. There is also mild anemia (low MCH), elevated creatinine, and normal inflammatory markers except for a slightly raised CRP. These findings suggest acute systemic illness with possible infection or inflammation, impaired oxygenation, and coagulopathy. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
